verdict: Jira: Choose Jira when software delivery, sprints and DevOps integration are the primary job — landscape on general Work OS lists. Scores use the project-management editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
tradeoffs: Seat minimums and AI credit bundles vs published per-seat floors
Work OS breadth vs specialist timeline / PDF / remote / desktop depth
Automation and reporting depth vs ease of use for small teams
Included AI credits vs paid AI add-ons or credit top-ups
recommendation: Choose Jira when software delivery, sprints and DevOps integration are the primary job — landscape on general Work OS lists. Compare Linear for a modern eng UX, ClickUp/Asana for cross-functional Work OS, and Trello for lightweight boards.
editorialNotes: Project-management Priority-1 batch. Approved on project-management-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=eng-tracker. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Steep for non-engineers — admin/workflow complexity is the classic Jira trade-off.
Best-in-class for sprints, backlogs, epics and issue workflows for software delivery.
Powerful automation rules; often needs admin skill to keep healthy.
Issue comments strong; docs collaboration usually pairs with Confluence — held at 6 for PM-suite comparison.
Deep DevOps + Atlassian ecosystem (Bitbucket, Confluence, GitHub/GitLab).
Dashboards, velocity and advanced roadmaps (Premium+) serve eng managers well.
Proven at enterprise software-org scale — top scalability score in this set.
Free ≤10 and ~$8 Standard floors are strong for eng teams. Affiliate economics excluded.
Atlassian Intelligence exists as add-on/bundle — not the product’s centre of gravity vs Motion/ClickUp Brain.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine project-management editorial criteria using the category weights (work planning 15, automation & workflows 14, ease of use 12, collaboration 12, integrations 12, reporting 10, value 10, scalability 9, AI 6), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — work OS / PM peers, timeline specialists, and adjacent PDF / remote-access / desktop-workspace tools are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
